title: Multilinear Extensions of Games
abstract: <jats:p> The multilinear extension of an n-person game v is a function defined on the n-cube I<jats:sup>N</jats:sup> which is linear in each variable and which coincides with v at the conrners of the cube, satisfying f(x) = v({i ∣ x<jats:sub>i</jats:sub> = 1}). Multilinear extensions are useful as a help in computing the values of large games, and give a generalization of the Shapley value. </jats:p>
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
